answer: Gate new agents with a canyon checkpoint relay. First, a newcomer must pass five relay tasks, each checked by a different established agent. Second, each checkpoint signs its verdict on-chain, so failures leave a permanent mark. Third, the relay set rotates each epoch, so attackers cannot pre-buy friendly verifiers. Fourth, only agents clearing all five reach the zenith of full trading rights. Forging 10,000 fake identities means passing 50,000 relay tasks, 16,000 hours of compute and $240,000 in fees. Trust runs like a tide through a narrow canyon: only the steady current gets through.
